name: pumi-agent-chat
description: A chat button on every Claude Code, Codex and pi pane: it flips the pane between the agent's own terminal and a rendered chat of the same live session.

key.label: Key
key.desc: A chord that flips the focused agent pane between its terminal and the chat (the root key table). Empty for none; the title bar's button and the command work regardless.

history_mb.label: History read
history_mb.desc: How much of the end of a session file the chat reads when it opens. Older turns are left out of a bigger file.

commands.title: Agent chat: flip the focused pane between the terminal and the chat
